jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production Wisp chibi animation sprite sheet. Input image is exact character/style and standing pose reference. Create SIX full-body frames in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows grid, equal square cells, read left to right then next row. Same pink hair black bows white black-trimmed dress white stockings black shoes. Match reference proportions exactly. Feet stay planted in identical stance and position in all cells, torso/root and head scale constant. Only arms, eyes, mouth and very subtle head movement animate. True transparent PNG alpha background, no checkerboard, no scenery, no drawn mouse pointer, no text or labels. Full silhouettes including hair and shoes, generous empty margins in every square cell, no touching neighboring frames. Final frames will each be 512x512 and last100ms. body_cursor_caught: gentle brief delight after an imaginary catch. 1 hands forward closing a grabbing gesture, eyes attentive. 2 hands close together near chest, pleased realization. 3 closed hands slightly raised near chest, joyful smile, open happy eyes. 4 small pleased smile with gently closed happy eyes. 5 relaxing hands back toward reference near collar, eyes reopen. 6 exact neutral attentive reference pose, hands by collar. No jumping, no bending knees, no foot movement.
jobs.alphaPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: attached six-frame sprite sheet. Remove the ENTIRE painted gray checkerboard background, including spaces between hair strands, legs and arms. Return actual PNG RGBA transparency with alpha=0 outside the six characters. Do NOT render a checkerboard visualization into RGB pixels. Preserve all six characters exactly, same layout, colors, white stockings and dress, facial expressions and complete fine hair outlines. No redraw, no missing frames. The requested deliverable is a genuinely transparent cutout sprite sheet.
